documentation.content: More than 20 rejected api tokens at __SERVICE__ (__STAGE__) in 5 minutes. Each has a warn line {auth: 'rejected', reason} with reqId. Reasons: missing, malformed, bad-signature, expired, not-yet-valid, bad-issuer, bad-audience, bad-claims. A burst of `bad-signature` after a deploy means the app and the api hold different API_TOKEN_SECRET values (Vercel vs Secret Manager; finish the rotation runbook in infra/README.md). A burst of `expired` from one userId is a stale admin tab. Many IPs with mixed reasons is a scan: the per-IP limits hold; read the reqIds. Query: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND jsonPayload.auth="rejected". Change this policy by editing cloudrun/monitoring/auth-failed.json and running apply-alerts.sh.
